title: SingleCellBrowser
bodyHtml:
Single-Cell Browser

Explore interactive visualizations of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. Datasets include individuals studies from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), individual studies from the literature, and integrated human tissue reference maps developed using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) from projects funded by the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health (FNIH) and additional external sources. Within a selected dataset, visualize interactive plots of cell type clusters, gene expression, cell type abundance, and marker gene expression. Query a gene name and filter results using the desired parameters. To begin, select a tissue type in the table below. Please be patient, as data may take time to load.

To explore computationally derived gene programs and literature-based cell states from the integrated maps, visit the Cell State Browser. To compare two datasets, visit the Single Cell Dataset Comparator.

If you use these maps or their underlying data, please review our Citation Policies.
